description: Implementation of the gl::FramebufferAttachment class and related classes/functions for managing framebuffer attachments in OpenGL ES context within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachment
classes.description: Represents a framebuffer attachment, such as a texture or renderbuffer, with methods for attachment management and querying properties.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachment::Target
classes.description: Represents the target of a framebuffer attachment, including binding point and texture image index.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachmentObject
classes.description: Base class for objects that can be attached to a framebuffer, providing methods for attachment and content initialization.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a resource (texture, renderbuffer, surface) to the framebuffer attachment with specified parameters.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches any resource from the framebuffer attachment.

methods.name: initializeContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of the attachment resource, used for robust resource initialization.

methods.name: getAttachmentRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target associated with the attachment.
